summary: Little Town is a light-medium worker placement game where you gather resources from a shared grid and build up your town with buildings that give ongoing bonuses. There's a clever tension in building things others can use (for a fee) versus keeping efficient combos to yourself.
criticised: can feel a bit dry or mechanical
limited replayability once patterns are learned
little direct player interaction beyond space contention

interaction.kind: worker placement contention and paying rent on shared buildings

scoring.why: points come from buildings built, resources banked, and end-game bonuses combined
